subject: Private deploy: version-bump safety ladder & maintenance gating
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: AcmeCorp SRE <sre@acmecorp.com>, AcmeOps <acme-ops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deploy: version-bump safety ladder & maintenance gating

Hi team —

Thanks for the heads up on the planned maintenance. I wanted to align on a concrete safety ladder for the version bump in the private VPC bundle (customer-managed control plane + on-prem inference nodes). Proposed high-level play:

- Pre-window: create pinned snapshot (pin v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0 candidate) and export KV prefixes for hot paths.
- Canary ring (2 hosts): apply new runtime + quantized model variant, run synthetic regen traffic and perf/latency checks (5m soak).
- Gradual ramp: 10% -> 33% -> 66% -> 100% with 15m observation between steps.
- Gate metrics: error rate (5xx) < 0.5%, median p99 latency delta < +50ms, unit cost delta within expected band.
- Rollback ladder: immediate pinback to v1.4.2 + warm cache restore from exported snapshots, circuit-break request routing to hosted fallback if rollback fails.

Operational asks for Acme:
- Confirm firewall egress rules allow pods to reach our private artifact registry for the candidate image (registry.redwood-inference.internal:443).
- Maintain node drain window of 20m per node and provide a list of critical services that cannot be drained.
- Identify a point-of-contact during the window with escalation privileges to trigger pinback.

Attachments: I’ve attached the initial \"pinning-ladder-v1.xlsx\" and a draft checklist. I’m also linking a short runbook. Please review and flag any network/security constraints we should add to the gates.

Next steps: If this looks reasonable, we’ll schedule a 60-minute preflight with your SREs and run the dry-run on staging.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): pinning-ladder-v1.xlsx, vpc-maintenance-checklist.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, AcmeCorp SRE <sre@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy: version-bump safety ladder & maintenance gating

Rishi — thanks, this is a solid draft. A couple of quick notes from infra:

- For the registry reachability check please add a TCP probe (443) from a pod in each AZ — we’ve seen asymmetric firewall rules cause flakes.
- We should avoid any GLB changes during the window; if Acme wants to change their LB settings we’ll need a separate approval.
- Can we add an explicit KV cache verification step post-canary? (list prefixes, sample keys) — I’ll add that to the checklist.

I’ll queue the dry-run slot for next Wed 04/28 unless Acme requests otherwise.

-Monica
Staff Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Monica —

Appreciate the clarity. A few constraints from Acme SRE side:

1) We have a maintenance freeze window for billing across some downstream services between 03:00-07:00 UTC on Thursdays. Can you confirm the time ranges the ladder expects? We prefer a local-business-hours window if possible.
2) Our network team is strict about outbound TLS SNI; please provide the exact certificate SANs for registry.redwood-inference.internal and artifact fetching.
3) For rollback: we need clear SLA attachments on the fallback hosted route — if your pinback fails and we failover to hosted, what is the expected consistency behavior for ephemeral caches and in-flight requests?

We can provide a single-point-of-contact (Me, Javier) during the window; I’ll also add our on-call escalation (oncall+acme@snowflakeops.com).

-Javier
Senior SRE, Acme Corp

Attachment(s): none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Javier Torres <sre@acmecorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy: version-bump safety ladder & maintenance gating

Thanks Javier — answers inline and added a short ops playbook (attached runbook-v2.md).

1) Window: the ladder is time-agnostic (can run any time) but our recommend is 01:00-05:00 local Acme time to reduce user impact; for your billing freeze we can shift to 18:00-22:00 UTC on Wednesday as an alternative. Please confirm which slot you prefer.

2) Registry certs: SANs = [registry.redwood-inference.internal, repo.redwood-inference.internal, auth.redwood-inference.internal]. We’ll send the cert chain via your secure channel and add hashing for integrity checks.

3) Failover semantics: if pinback fails (e.g., corrupted image or runtime panic), fallback to hosted will be performed with a 2-phase drain:
   - Phase A: stop new inference requests to affected nodes, maintain streaming keepalives for open sessions up to 30s.
   - Phase B: route new sessions to hosted with a header x-rw-fallback:acme to preserve routing logs.
Post-failover consistency: ephemeral KV caches will be stale — we’ll run a background rehydrate (best-effort) and tag affected requests for a brief period. We will include this behavior in the preflight readout so your product team understands the transient inconsistencies.

I’ve attached runbook-v2.md and the updated maintenance checklist (vpc-maintenance-checklist.pdf). Also note: we will take an extra snapshot of the pin state before applying the canary.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): runbook-v2.md, vpc-maintenance-checklist.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Javier Torres <sre@acmecorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private deploy: version-bump safety ladder & maintenance gating

Javier — thanks for the quick review and for offering an SRE POC. We’re aligned to proceed with the following commitments from Redwood side:

- Preflight dry-run on staging (2026-04-28 22:00 UTC) — Redwood will own the run and publish a postmortem-style checklist within 6 hours.
- During the live window Redwood will provide two engineers (Rishi + Karthik) and an operations channel in Slack; Acme to provide on-call contact.
- We will deliver the certificate chain and integrity hashes to your security mailbox (secure@acmecorp.com) before 2026-04-23.
- If an automatic pinback is triggered, Redwood will attempt warm cache restore; if that fails within 20 minutes we will initiate hosted fallback and notify product/ops.

Please confirm the maintenance slot preference (Wed 18:00-22:00 UTC or Thu 01:00-05:00 local). Once confirmed we’ll lock the change window and circulate a short mutual action plan (MAP).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
